import re

def getgrid(text,label):
 s=text.index(label)+len(label)
 # strip newline spaces
 rows=[]
 for line in text[s:].strip().splitlines():
  line=line.strip()
  if not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9 ]+',line): break
  vals=list(map(int,line.split()))
  if len(vals)!=30: break
  rows.append(vals)
  if len(rows)==30: break
 assert len(rows)==30,(label,len(rows))
 return rows
